name: A Country Practice
description: A Country Practice was an Australian television drama series. At its inception, one of the longest-running of its kind, produced by James Davern of JNP Productions, who had wrote the pilot episode and entered a script contest for the network in 1979, coming third and winning a merit award. It ran on the Seven Network for 1,058 episodes from 18 November 1981 to 22 November 1993. It was produced in ATN-7's production facility at Epping, Sydney. After its lengthy run on the seven network it was picked up by network ten with a mainly new cast from April to November 1994 for 30 episodes, although the ten series was not as successful as its predecessor . The Channel Seven series was also filmed on location in Pitt Town, while, the Channel Ten series was filmed on location in Emerald, Victoria.

videos.title: In General Practice (2)
videos.overview: Dr Simon Bowen refuses to prescribe the contraceptive pill to a fifteen year old girl without her father's permission. The girl is torn between her father and her insistent boyfriend.

videos.title: Town Tragedy (1)
videos.overview: A very serious accident upsets the townsfolk leaving questions unanswered, and Dr. Elliott battles for the survival of one of the injured.

videos.title: Town Tragedy (2)
videos.overview: Questions arise about the tragic incident and Dr. Elliott and nurse Shirley Dean work to protect Andy MacKay from the small town gossip.

videos.title: The Itinerants (1)

videos.title: The Itinerants (2)
videos.overview: Brendan battles with a stubborn angry patient, and Molly goes to the Sales yard to buy a dog, and ends up with something completely different.

videos.title: They Shoot Cows? (1)
videos.overview: Brendan battles with a stubborn angry patient, and Molly goes to the Sales yard to buy a dog, and ends up with something completely different.

videos.title: They Shoot Cows? (2)
videos.overview: There's a fire in the Wandin Valley Community Hospital, and Brendan Jones finds out who caused it. Simon Bowen has to make a decision about the right and wrong of shortening a life.

videos.title: Coming Home (1)
videos.overview: Dr. Elliott gets up to mischief with an old boy of the Valley and gives Sgt. Gilroy a few headaches. Dr. Bowen finds a companion although not quite what he was looking for.

videos.title: Coming Home (2)
videos.overview: Matron Kertesz takes over as District Nurse and has to care for a young man recently crippled and struggles between her profession and her emotions.

videos.title: Secrets (1)
videos.overview: Shirley Dean is involved in an accident and makes police work very difficult for Sgt. Gilroy. Nurse Brendan Jones saves the life of a young asthmatic.

videos.title: Secrets (2)
videos.overview: Dr Bowen fights to make the town's stubborn bus driver see how he can endanger the lives of passengers with his illness.

videos.title: Alternatives (1)
videos.overview: Molly's glamorous model friend comes to stay, driving Brendan crazy and causing Vicki Dean some jealous moments.

videos.title: Alternatives (2)
videos.overview: Dr. Elliot faces a threat of his past being revealed when he takes the side of alternative medicine for a dying child.

videos.title: Teamwork (2)
videos.overview:
The team at the hospital - with the help of Shirley, Frank, Vicky, and Robert Bowen - work together to treat the passengers of the bus accident.

Molly confronts the bank manager about her loan.

After burning his hands at the accident scene, Frank moves in with Shirley and Vicky so that Shirley can take care of him.

Robert expresses some reserved praise for Simon.

videos.title: Suffer Children (1)
videos.overview:
Vicky secures a high-profile job treating a Yarraman colt trained by Neil Stephens, but worries that Stephens is excessively pushing his reluctant daughter Robin into constant showjumping training. Meanwhile, Terence becomes concerned about Neil's wife Jill, who requests that Terence sterilize her.

Simon suspects that a young girl is being physically abused by her father.

Molly decides to go into business breeding turkeys.

Marta spends an evening at Terence's vineyard with Alex Popovich.

Shirley helps Frank work on his article for the Horticultural Society.

videos.title: Suffer Children (2)
videos.overview:
After Robin is admitted to hospital as the result of her horse-riding accident, Simon searches for the truth about the previous injuries - which were treated by Terence - that become apparent on her X-rays.

Molly decides to start business as a yabbi farmer.

Marta's friendship with Alex continues to deepen, with Alex gifting her with a wood-carving of The General.

Shirley's attempts to get Frank to move back into his own house with a farewell dinner backfire.

videos.title: Agrophobic Sons & Other Lovers (1)
videos.overview:
Terence comes to the aid of a woman suffering from agoraphobia.

Molly assists at the veterinary practice when Vicky falls ill, while Simon uses this as an opportunity to get closer to her.

A three-year-old child is treated by the team after falling off a moving plough.

Shirley continues to replace her craving for cigarettes with food.

Marta learns that the Hospital Workers' Union has advised workers to strike for a pay rise, leaving only the medical staff to run the hospital.

videos.title: Agrophobic Sons & Other Lovers (2)
videos.overview:
Shirley, Molly, and Vicky assist at the hospital during the strike.

Simon performs his first operation in the valley on Kathy Pieri. However, what is at first thought to be an appendicitis turns out to be something quite different.

Terence worries that problems at home may be the cause of Brett Morgan's anxiety and inability to study or sleep.

Vicky becomes upset when Terence refers to his wife in Sydney.

videos.title: Golden Fleece - Part 1
videos.overview: A young boy, bored and lonely turns to petty vandalism and is given two weeks "hard labour" at the hospital where he befriends an elderly male patient - his first friend.

videos.title: Golden Fleece - Part 2
videos.overview: Doctor Elliott shocks Wandin Valley when his new friend arrives. The young boy is devastated when the old man dies but decides to take on the care of his dog.

videos.title: Teamwork - Part 1
videos.overview: A young diabetic's condition saves her from the disaster that befalls her fellow students. Simon's father arrives in Wandin Valley.

videos.title: Teamwork - Part 2

videos.title: Suffer Little Children - Part 1

videos.title: Suffer Little Children - Part 2
videos.overview: Simon is unrelenting in his pressure on Terence to report the case to the relevant authorities. How long can Frank and Shirley continue living under the same roof?

videos.title: Mates - Part 1
videos.overview: The local tennis coach saves a young boy's life but finds his own at risk. Marta Kertesz finds that a friend has become an admirer.

videos.title: Mates - Part 2
videos.overview: The prejudices and hypocrisy of a small town destroy two favourite residents. There are big money stakes on Shirley's determination to give up cigarettes.

videos.title: Sons & Lovers - Part 1
videos.overview: Dr Elliot has a tough time treating a woman whose problems are more mental than physical. Vicky collapses in her surgery and is confined to bed.

videos.title: Sons & Lovers - Part 2

videos.title: I Know Where She's Gone - Part 1
videos.overview: Frank's job is at risk and he's out to prove that he's a tough cop. Meanwhile, Marta and Molly organize a demonstration.

videos.title: I Know Where She's Gone - Part 2
videos.overview: Marta is reminded of the secret police in Hungary when two city detectives come to investigate a murder. Frank is forgiven and becomes the town hero. Starring -

videos.title: Little Knowledge - Part 1
videos.overview: Marta fears general health and Vicki comes to the rescue. Molly is branded an eccentric and a nuisance.

videos.title: Little Knowledge - Part 2
videos.overview: Terence's investigation of a patient's illness brings an unexpected result. Shirly finds an unusual way of not having to go jogging with Frank.

videos.title: A Pit To Hiss In - Part 1
videos.overview: Molly leaves Brendan and the townsfolk are sure it's for good. Frank and Shirley are keeping secrets from each other.

videos.title: A Pit To Hiss In - Part 2
videos.overview: Shirley's on a strict diet, but bears a strong resemblance to Miss Piggy. Vicki worries about her young assistant, whose help is sometimes more trouble than it's worth.

videos.title: Sore Throat - Part 1
videos.overview: Tempers flair from both sides when there's a threat of big industry invading Wandin Valley and Molly employs some fancy fighting tactics.

videos.title: Sore Throat - Part 2
videos.overview: Simon proves that doctors are as vulnerable to dangerous illnesses as their patients. Things look grim for Frank and Shirley's relationship when Frank is seen with a very attractive woman.

videos.title: Beatin' Round The Bush - Part 1
videos.overview: Terence receives a beautiful visitor who causes him heaps of problems.. and she happens to be his ex-wife Rowena. The hospital staff vote Dr. Simon Bowen as the world's worst patient.

videos.title: Beatin' Round The Bush - Part 2
videos.overview: Marta feels threatened by Rowena's arrival and the two women have a talk. Frank makes a few changes to his image to suit Laurel, but finds his life is changing faster than he likes.

videos.title: Never Called Me Mother - Part 1
videos.overview: Vicky's in for a big surprise when she meets her enemy, the new specialist vet in town. There's unwelcome competition for the doctors as well.

videos.title: Never Called Me Mother - Part 2
videos.overview: Is the relationship between Shirl and Frank, on or off? They both have very different ideas on the subject. Simon may be a little out of his depth when he deals with hallucinations.

videos.title: Shootin' Through - Part 1
videos.overview: Shirley's meeting with Vicky's boyfriend is a total disaster. A father's negligence in leaving a loaded gun where his children can find it spells danger.

videos.title: Shootin' Through - Part 2
videos.overview: How does Simon Bowen react when he meets Vicky's new boyfriend? Meanwhile, an emergency operation at Wandin Valley hospital seems imminent and the life of a young child is at stake.

videos.title: Pig In A Poke - Part 1

videos.title: Pig In A Poke - Part 2
videos.overview: Vicky's romance strikes difficulties when she discovers some startling information about Peter. There's chaos in the Valley when actors from a radio serial wind up in hospital.

videos.title: Did She Fall - Part 1
videos.overview: Vicky creates havoc in the Dean household when she leaves home. Meanwhile, Molly and Brendan are in for a few surprises when their live-in help divulges her thoughts on certain moral issues.

videos.title: Did She Fall - Part 2
videos.overview: Frustrated by the hospital's lack of support, Marta starts looking for another job. In the meantime, there is growing evidence that Shirley Dean's secret fear may actually be true.

videos.title: Loves Labour Lost - Part 1
videos.overview: Shirley receives some news which could endanger her future with Frank. Meanwhile, a very serious disease strikes a newborn baby and Terence investigates.

videos.title: Close Encounters Of The Wrong Kind - Part 1
videos.overview: There are strange lights in the sky, a boy suffers mysterious burns and talks about a crashed spaceship. Shirley is very depressed as a result of the operation, or is it Frank?

videos.title: Close Encounters Of The Wrong Kind - Part 2
videos.overview: A young boy is struck by a disease that can ruin his future and Terence can't get any answer as to the cause. The Hospital Board appears to be scheming to remove Marta.

videos.title: The Second Coming - Part 1
videos.overview: Shirley's mum arrives causing chaos in the Dean household and upsetting some of the locals. Terence and Simon worry for the health and life of the local priest who has a fight on his hands.

videos.title: The Second Coming - Part 2
videos.overview: Frank and Shirley's engagement party creates arguments and a few surprises. Simon tries to cope with a young deserted mother who has misinterpreted his professional care and attention.

videos.title: Come Blow Your Own Horn - Part 1
videos.overview: Terence and Simon are both attracted to the glamorous new receptionist at the clinic. Shirley is feeling unwanted and unloved, and her mother's interference in the wedding plans doesn't help.

videos.title: Come Blow Your Own Horn - Part 2
videos.overview: There is confusion between two brothers, one of whom is a well known war hero. The whole town turns up for a funeral.

videos.title: Frankie And Johnny - Part 1
videos.overview: A dangerous escaped criminal returns to Wandin Valley and Frank is forced to take action. Brendan and Molly have an argument and Brendan ends up spending the night in a pig pen.

videos.title: Frankie And Johnny - Part 2
videos.overview: Terence reveals a closely guarded secret from his past. There is fun and a surprise for the ladies at Shirley's shower tea.

videos.title: The Odd Couple - Part 1
videos.overview: Shirley and Frank have wedding jitters and Shirley has second thoughts. After Frank's bucks party, Frank and Simon deliver a baby.

videos.title: The Odd Couple - Part 2
videos.overview: It's great celebrations in the Valley for Frank and Shirley's wedding. There's a fear that a snake may ruin the ceremony.

videos.title: A Fearful Thing - Part 1
videos.overview: Frank and Shirley return from their honeymoon but find living together isn't easy. An abandoned baby is left at the hospital.

videos.title: A Fearful Thing - Part 2
videos.overview: Wandin Valley fears the outbreak of a tropical disease and Terence and Simon battle against the small town prejudices.

videos.title: Win Some, Lose Some - Part 1
videos.overview: Shirley loses a daughter and Simon finds a flatmate. Terence's daughter arrives on his doorstep to stay.

videos.title: Win Some, Lose Some - Part 2
videos.overview: Molly and Brendan receive some very exciting news. The local BMX champion becomes very ill just before his big race.

videos.title: Eyes Of The Beholder - Part 1
videos.overview: Frank is reprimanded for neglecting his professional duties due to the excitement of being a newly-wed. Brendan is suffering because of Molly's pregnancy.

videos.title: Eyes Of The Beholder - Part 2
videos.overview: To improve farm profitability, Molly is faced with having to get rid of Doris. Meanwhile, Sophie gets into trouble and Terence doesn't know how to deal with his daughter's radical behaviour.

videos.title: Weight For Age - Part 1
videos.overview: Terence is concerned about a patient not responding to treatment. A young school boy takes desperate measures to become a jockey.

videos.title: Weight For Age - Part 2
videos.overview: There's an unexpected twist at Frank and Shirley's bridge party. Sophie Elliott's interest in Brendan creates problems for Terence.

videos.title: Prisoner Of The Valley - Part 1
videos.overview: When Simon is attracted to a beautiful woman he learns of her dark past in Wandin Valley. Meanwhile, Terrance worries about stories of Sophie and her romantic entanglement.

videos.title: Prisoner Of The Valley - Part 2
videos.overview: Brendan and Molly's marriage is put under pressure by town gossip. Simon suffers from the small-mindedness of the Valley people. Starring -

videos.title: Cheap Dreams - Part 1
videos.overview: When a bikie gang appears in Wandin Valley, fear strikes the town. Simon worries about Fatso's nocturnal habits. Starring -

videos.title: Cheap Dreams - Part 2
videos.overview: The township turns against Frank when he sides with the bikies against a local. Meanwhile, Molly is upset at talks of leaving the valley.

videos.title: Occupational Hazard - Part 1
videos.overview: An angry farmer publicly slanders Vicky and assaults her for mistreating his cattle. Brendan is very upset about Miss Bird's senility and resists taking her to a nursing home.

videos.title: Occupational Hazard - Part 2
videos.overview: Marta and Terence try to further their relationship, but circumstances are against them. Stock are dying from a rare disease and there are worries for the safety of the Valley's inhabitants.

videos.title: Hear No Evil - Part 1
videos.overview: Marta shows growing affection for Ben Prescott, the Pony Club manager and Terence is jeolous. Meanwhile, Brendan tries to help a family whose son appears to be troubled by violence at home.

videos.title: Hear No Evil - Part 2
videos.overview: Shirley asks Frank to pose nude for her painting. A colleague of Simon's father comes to stay and Simon gets a pleasant surprise.

videos.title: The Luck Of The Draw - Part 1
videos.overview: Simon has some news for Vicky - his father has asked him to join the family practice. Shirley's painting of Frank provides great amusement at the club.

videos.title: The Luck Of The Draw - Part 2
videos.overview: Ben tells Marta of a problem that may put an end to their relationship. Brendan discovers the source of the strange noises that have been upsetting Molly.

videos.title: One For The Road - Part 1
videos.overview: Vicky and Terence have an accident, and Vicky blames herself. Marta's professionalism is questioned due to her personal involvement with a seriously ill patient.

videos.title: One For The Road - Part 2
videos.overview: Marta and Ben's relationship is put under great strain. A bitter argument divides Terence and Marta.

videos.title: A Fair Day's Work - Part 1
videos.overview: There's a fire at the Jones' farm and Brendan has to break the news to Molly, but she has some bad news of her own.

videos.title: A Fair Day's Work - Part 2
videos.overview: Bob Hatfield takes ill and convinced that he may die, reveals an intimate secret from his past to Cookie. Terence is obviously upset about Marta's relationship with Ben.

videos.title: No Apparent Reason - Part 1
videos.overview: Simon arranges a beautiful blind date for Terence. A much hoped for birth turns to tragedy for a Wandin Valley couple.

videos.title: No Apparent Reason - Part 2
videos.overview: Shirley reprimands Terence for his treatment of Marta. An engagement is announced.

videos.title: Road To Nowhere - Part 1
videos.overview: Terence has to tell a close friend some shattering news. Shirley and Simon feel they need to teach school students about sex.

videos.title: Coming Ready Or Not - Part 1
videos.overview: The treatment of two patients causes friction between Terence and Simon. Molly's mother arrives and causes problems for Brendan.

videos.title: Coming Ready Or Not - Part 2
videos.overview: Molly and Brendan become proud parents. Shirley and Frank rethink their marriage.

videos.title: What It Takes - Part 1
videos.overview: The arrival of old Dr Clarke upsets Terence when the doctor tries to take over. The old fashioned attitudes of a teenage father drives her to extremes.

videos.title: What It Takes - Part 2
videos.overview: It appears that Molly's mum will settle in Wandin Valley, and Molly and Brendan are horrified. Dr Clarke causes problems for Terence, and some patients.

videos.title: The Second Deadly Sin - Part 1
videos.overview: Brendan is upset about not having enough time with his baby. There is hope of gold discovery in the Valley.

videos.title: The Second Deadly Sin - Part 2
videos.overview: Cookie resigns from the club after fighting with Councillor Muldoon. The whole town team together for a rescue.

videos.title: The Seeds Of Discontent - Part 1
videos.overview: Simon prepares for his radio debut. There's friction between Brendan Jones and the relief nurse.

videos.title: The Seeds Of Discontent - Part 2
videos.overview: There's general excitement, but also arguments about the garden fete at the Gilroys. Terence becomes sick while investigating the mystery illness of an elderly lady.

videos.title: Sign Of Affection - Part 1
videos.overview: Molly finds motherhood trying, she is tired and unhappy. Vicky investigates the mystery death of some cattle.

videos.title: Sign Of Affection - Part 2
videos.overview: There are some surprises at the Wandin Valley Hospital Beauty Quest. Molly has to adjust to a change in her relationship with Chloe.

videos.title: Field Of Thunder - Part 1
videos.overview: Shirley plans a holiday but Frank doesn't want to join her. Marta is worried her new house is a mistake.

videos.title: Field Of Thunder - Part 2
videos.overview: A dying patient makes his final protest. Terence solves a young boy's embarrassing problem.

videos.title: The Push - Part 1
videos.overview: An unemployed teenager suffers a stroke and his friends organise his rehabilitation. Marta is plagued by telephone calls from a mystery intruder.

videos.title: The Push - Part 2
videos.overview: "The Push" group, a group of unemployed teenagers, make progress with one of their member's rehabilitation from a stroke. Marta discovers the identity of the intruder.

videos.title: Acts Of Kindness - Part 1
videos.overview: Vickey's matchmaking backfires. Simon's play strikes big problems.

videos.title: Acts Of Kindness - Part 2
videos.overview: Molly thinks she may be pregnant again. The local chemist is suspected of murdering his annoying wife.

videos.title: A Human Reaction - Part 1
videos.overview: A patient almost dies and Simon blames himself. Molly argues with Brendan and Simon about inoculating Chloe.

videos.title: A Human Reaction - Part 2
videos.overview: The bad luck of a farmer affects the whole Valley. Frank is proud of Shirley's success at darts, but doesn't know her secret.

videos.title: The Show Down - Part 1
videos.overview: Wandin Valley Bush Hospital is threatened with closure and the town residents fight to keep it open.

videos.title: The Show Down - Part 2
videos.overview: An airplane crash reminds everyone why it is so important to maintain well equipped hospitals in rural areas - but such practical reasons are not always considered when politics are involved.

videos.title: Pie In The Sky - Part 1
videos.overview: Wandin Valley residents react with self-righteous indignation when two ex-criminals and three "ladies of the night" arrive in town.

videos.title: Pie In The Sky - Part 2
videos.overview: Esme and a number of the local ladies are so incensed by the presence of the "ladies of the night", that they decide to take things into their own hands.

videos.title: Stirring The Possum - Part 1
videos.overview: Esme's nephew Alwyn Watson returns to the Valley with his wife Mary. As a result of an accident, Alwyn is confined to a wheelchair, where he dreams of his huge insurance claim.

videos.title: Stirring The Possum - Part 2
videos.overview: Mr Brown, a mysterious visitor to the Valley, sparks those with guilty consciences to cleanse their souls.

videos.title: Cup Fever - Part 1
videos.overview: Wandin Valley Cup fever strikes with its customary force. Apart from the S.P. Bookie run by Cookie, the racing committee is faced with an audacious confidence trick.

videos.title: Cup Fever - Part 2
videos.overview: Terence and Marta's growing relationship becomes impossible to hide.

videos.title: Little Voices - Part 1
videos.overview: Janice is discovered caring for her baby brother after both have been abandoned by their drug addict mother. Janice is only nine years old and the baby is going through heroin withdrawal symptoms.

videos.title: Little Voices - Part 2
videos.overview: Ross and Yvonne McLean, a prosperous but childless couple in their forties are finally forced to accept that they cannot produce children.

videos.title: Grace And Favour - Part 1
videos.overview: Rex Munro and Clarrie King maintain a feud, which began with their fathers, by quarrelling over an access road running through Rex's property.  The feud excalates into violence.

videos.title: Grace And Favour - Part 2
videos.overview: A lonely, elderly woman and a bereaved and lonely young truckie form a friendship based on mutual interests. Molly sparks off a one-woman campaign against battery farming.

videos.title: Breaking Point - Part 1
videos.overview: Billy Perkins suffers from incurable and advanced emphysema, as a result of many years of heavy smoking. Unable to cope with the fear of a slow and lingering death, Billy commits suicide.

videos.title: Breaking Point - Part 2
videos.overview: Vicky's feelings for Terence are exposed as she becomes so unhappy with the confirmation of the romance between Terence and Marta.

videos.title: Just Another Patient - Part 1
videos.overview: Des Ward, an ex-professional cricketer, whose career has been ruined by a shooting accident, returns to the Valley. Des is dragged out of his self pity and depression by Frank.

videos.title: Just Another Patient - Part 2
videos.overview: Terence Elliott is recovering from his heart attack, but is becomming increasingly irritated at the over-protective manner of his friends and colleagues.

videos.title: Truth And Consequences - Part 1
videos.overview: A newborn baby needs a blood transfusion but Simon is mystified when neither mother nor father's blood group is compatible.

videos.title: Truth And Consequences - Part 2
videos.overview: Nigel Fairbairn, a city-bred locum arrives to help Simon during Terence's convalescence, and is seconded to help fight a bush fire which breaks out in the Valley bringing death in its wake.

videos.title: Who Cares - Part 1
videos.overview: An aimless teenage boy dies unexpectedly on the operatingtable. Simon and Nigel's careers are at stake until Terence performs an autopsy.

videos.title: Who Cares - Part 2
videos.overview: A gang of cattle-duffers in the Valley involve many of the locals who succumb to the lure of cheap, freshly killed beef.

videos.title: September Song - Part 1
videos.overview: Kath has been caught up in rearing her grandchildren and running her son's household since her daughter-in-law died.  Until she meets a retired solicitor, and realises she has her own life to lead.

videos.title: September Song - Part 2
videos.overview: Councillor Muldoon attempts to close down the Wandin Valley caravan park. Malcolm, a Wandin Valley farmer, is seriously injured and Terence and Simon have to amputate his leg.

videos.title: The Reckoning - Part 1
videos.overview: Hilary Randall is totally unprepared when her husband Graham suffers a stroke. Faced with a mountain of bills, and terrified that Graham may need constant care, Hilary is at first unable to cope.

videos.title: The Reckoning - Part 2
videos.overview: Marta and Terence decide to marry. Complications arise when a mystery man, linked with Marta's past in Hungary, arrives in the Valley.

videos.title: The Winds Of Change - Part 1
videos.overview: Gale-force winds wreak havoc in Wandin Valley. Fallen trees and power wires leave several people injured.  The whole town pulls together during the emergency.

videos.title: The Winds Of Change - Part 2
videos.overview: Bela, the hero of Marta's student days and her first love, arrives in Wandin Valley.  Marta hides Bela at her house as he is an illegal immigrant and forces her to lie to Terence.

videos.title: Love And Glory - Part 1
videos.overview: A group of nine year old boys find some gelignite and decide to make a bomb. The explosion comes sooner than expected and the badly injured boys are trapped in an over-turned bus.

videos.title: Love And Glory - Part 2
videos.overview: Marta is torn between her shared dreams with Bela and her future plans with Terence.  Dramatically Marta leaves with Bela to continue their work together in the underground movement in Hungary.

videos.title: Life Wasn't Meant To Be Easy - Part 1
videos.overview: A young mother and recent widow, seems to be managing so well, running the drought-stricken farm and raising her two children.  Pam is refused credit and her brave front begins to crumble.

videos.title: Life Wasn't Meant To Be Easy - Part 2
videos.overview: Terence succumbs to depression and self-pity over Marta. However, he is instrumental in preventing Pam from destroying her own life and that of the children.

videos.title: Another Man's Poison - Part 1
videos.overview: A farmer's carelessness with pesticides puts a little girl's life at risk and kills Molly's dog.

videos.title: Another Man's Poison - Part 2
videos.overview: Molly is suspicious of an old man until the old drover becomes Brendan's patient.

videos.title: Hair Of The Dog - Part 1
videos.overview: The erratic behaviour of a 16 year old girl is a mystery for Dr Elliott until he learns that his young patient is an alcoholic.

videos.title: Hair Of The Dog - Part 2
videos.overview: Brendan Jones' favourite patient, Mrs Coote, becomes attached to a labrador.

videos.title: See Ya - Part 1
videos.overview: A young boy is in danger of losing the sight in his eye as a result of a minor injury.  A corneal transplant operation in the Sydney Eye Hospital seems to be his only hope.

videos.title: See Ya - Part 2
videos.overview: Terence Elliott supports Dorothy Edgar in her intention to die with dignity, and to find some purpose in her death by donating her eyes to the Eye Bank.

videos.title: Warning Signs - Part 1
videos.overview: Frank's new offsider, Constable Perry Nolan, arrives in Wandin Valley.

videos.title: Warning Signs - Part 2
videos.overview: Tragedy strikes the Marsh family as a result of a road accident.  Councillor Muldoon finds himself the target of local hostility as the accident occurs on the notoriously dangerous crossroads.

videos.title: Fruit Of The Vine - Part 2

videos.title: A Woman's Place - Part 1
videos.overview: A shy teenage girl breaks away from the confines of her narrow minded fanatical father when she learns that she is an epileptic.

videos.title: A Woman's Place - Part 2
videos.overview: The new matron Maggie Sloan arrives at Wandin Valley Hospital.  Nursing staff and doctors are torn between admiration, irritation and fear at her methods.

videos.title: Still Life - Part 1
